mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, kb_id, session_id, user_id, query, rewritten_query, top_chunks, top_score, answer_type, retrieval_ms, rerank_ms, generate_ms, total_ms, created_at FROM kb_retrieval_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, tenant_id, kb_id, session_id, user_id, query, rewritten_query, top_chunks, top_score, answer_type, retrieval_ms, rerank_ms, generate_ms, total_ms, created_at FROM kb_retrieval_log WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND created_at > #{since} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_retrieval_log (tenant_id, kb_id, session_id, user_id, query, rewritten_query, top_chunks, top_score, answer_type, retrieval_ms, rerank_ms, generate_ms, total_ms, created_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{kbId}, #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{query}, #{rewrittenQuery}, #{topChunks}, #{topScore}, #{answerType}, #{retrievalMs}, #{rerankMs}, #{generateMs}, #{totalMs}, NOW())
